ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; advise the driver that the "I'm Here" flow requires a continuous 3+ minutes within 200 m after the tap (here only 2 min 55 s) before cancelling for no-show
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat contains only pickup/cancel logistics (F9, F10); the driver's statement (F12) is a factual no-show claim, not a threat, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation. No safety concern.

NS-0 routes this case: cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims rider no-show → NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 test:
(i) Arrival indicated — platform recorded arrival at 13:01:00 (F5) and the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 (F6). Noted as driver_tap.
(ii) At the tap the driver was 39 m from the pickup (F6) — within the 200 m data-layer radius. Satisfied.
(iii) Continuous wait > 3 minutes at the pickup after the tap: the record shows the driver stayed within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s after the tap (F6), and cancelled 4 min 30 s after arrival (F5). The 4 min 30 s from platform arrival (F5) includes time before the tap and is not the NS-1 (iii) measure; the post-tap figure is 2 min 55 s ≤ 3 min. Time before the tap does not count. The gap between the cancellation at 13:05:30 (F4/F3) and last continuous coverage is not a GPS hole that would let "still waiting" be presumed — the post-tap coverage is simply under the threshold.

Requirement (iii) fails → NS-2: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, refund_full of $6.61 (F4, F7). The driver's written claim of ">3 minutes after I'm Here" (F12) is a statement and yields to the timeline/GPS record (F5, F6).

NS-2's flag_account limb is not triggered: at the tap the driver was within 200 m (39 m, F6), so this is not abuse of the arrival button. RD-6 is not applicable (no route deviation, no RD-2 refund). Driver's no-show dispute history (F17: 1 upheld in 90 d) is profile data and cannot decide or flag this case alone.

Refund form: voucher per NS-7; within the 30-day window.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he waited more than 3 minutes after pressing 'I'm Here' conflicts with the timeline/GPS record: post-tap time within 200 m was only 2 min 55 s [F6], and cancellation came 4 min 30 s after arrival (platform arrival, not the tap) [F5]. System records override statements.

Cumulative 4 min 30 s within 200 m before cancellation is measured from first entry into the radius, not from the 'I'm Here' tap; NS-1 (iii) counts only continuous waiting after the tap, so this figure does not satisfy the requirement.
